map "https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToFHIRTypes" = "CdaToFHIRTypes"

// Mapping de CDA vers les FHIR Types (A partir des sources de Oliver Egger)

// Adapted from https://github.com/HL7/ccda-to-fhir/tree/master/mappings
// CDA:  http://build.fhir.org/ig/ahdis/cda-core-2.0/branches/master/index.html
// FHIR: http://hl7.org/fhir/r4/
// Déclaration des types CDA utilisés comme sources
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/ED|2.0.0-sd" alias ED as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/PN|2.0.0-sd" alias PN as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/II|2.0.0-sd" alias II as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/TS|2.0.0-sd" alias TS as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/CS|2.0.0-sd" alias CS as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/CE|2.0.0-sd" alias CE as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/ST|2.0.0-sd" alias ST as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/ON|2.0.0-sd" alias ON as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/EN|2.0.0-sd" alias EN as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/AD|2.0.0-sd" alias AD as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/TEL|2.0.0-sd" alias TEL as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/BL|2.0.0-sd" alias BL as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/IVL-TS|2.0.0-sd" alias IVL_TS as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/INT|2.0.0-sd" alias INT as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/CD|2.0.0-sd" alias CD as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/PQ|2.0.0-sd" alias PQ as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/RTO-PQ-PQ|2.0.0-sd" alias RTO_PQ_PQ as source
// Déclaration des types FHIR utilisés comme cibles
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Identifier|4.0.1" alias Identifier as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/instant|4.0.1" alias instant as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/code|4.0.1" alias code as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CodeableConcept|4.0.1" alias CodeableConcept as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Coding|4.0.1" alias Coding as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/string|4.0.1" alias string as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/HumanName|4.0.1" alias HumanName as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Address|4.0.1" alias Address as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ContactPoint|4.0.1" alias ContactPoint as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/boolean|4.0.1" alias boolean as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Period|4.0.1" alias Period as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/integer|4.0.1" alias integer as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/dateTime|4.0.1" alias dateTime as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/date|4.0.1" alias date as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Quantity|4.0.1" alias Quantity as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Ratio|4.0.1" alias Ratio as target

// Groupe générique de base (Sert de groupe parent pour les autres mappings)
group Any(source src, target tgt) {
  // Mapping de base sans transformation spécifique
  src -> tgt "base";
}

// Mapping CDA II vers FHIR Identifier
// II = Identifiant CDA
// Identifier = Identifiant FHIR
group II(source src : II, target tgt : Identifier) extends Any <<types>> {
  // Si root existe avec une extension, alors root devient le system en urn:oid
  src.root as r where (src.extension.exists()) -> tgt.system = append('urn:oid:', r) "root1";
  // Si root est un UUID sans extension, alors il est mappé comme urn:uuid
  src.root as r where (src.extension.empty() and src.root.matches('[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}')) ->  tgt.system = 'urn:ietf:rfc:3986',  tgt.value = ('urn:uuid:' + r.lower()) "rootuuid";
  // Si root est un OID sans extension, alors il devient une valeur urn:oid
  src.root as r where (src.extension.empty() and src.root.contains('.')) ->  tgt.system = 'urn:ietf:rfc:3986',  tgt.value = append('urn:oid:', r) "rootoid";
  // L’extension CDA devient la valeur de l’Identifier FHIR
  src.extension as e -> tgt.value = e;
  // Le nom de l’autorité d’assignation devient le display de l’assigner
  src.assigningAuthorityName as s ->  tgt.assigner as a,  a.display = s; // there's no equivalent for displayable in FHIR - and it probably will never matter, but if it does, it might map to Identifier.use.
  // Mapping de l’attribut displayable sous forme d’extension FHIR
  src.displayable as displayable -> tgt.extension as ext then {
    // URL de l’extension displayable
    displayable -> ext.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/cdaStructureDefinition/extension-displayable' "url";
    // Valeur de displayable convertie en string
    displayable.value as v -> ext.value = cast(v, 'string');
  } "extension";
}

// Mapping CDA INT vers FHIR integer
// INT = entier CDA
// integer = entier FHIR
group INT(source src : INT, target tgt : integer) extends Any <<types>> {
  // La valeur CDA devient la valeur FHIR
  src.value as v -> tgt.value = v "integer";
}

// Mapping des templateId CDA (Les templateId sont conservés dans des extensions FHIR)
group TemplateID(source template : II, target tgt) {
  // Création d’une extension pour stocker le templateId CDA
  template -> tgt.extension as ext then {
    // URL de l’extension templateID
    template -> ext.url = 'http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/templateID' "url";
    // Le templateId est transformé en Identifier FHIR
    template -> ext.value = create('Identifier') as value then II(template, value) "value";
  } "templateId";
}

// Mapping du negationIndicator CDA (La négation CDA est représentée comme modifierExtension FHIR)
group Negation(source negation : BL, target tgt) {
  // Création d’une modifierExtension pour indiquer la négation
  negation -> tgt.modifierExtension as ext then {
    // URL de l’extension negationIndicator
    negation -> ext.url = 'http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/negationIndicator' "url";
    // Valeur booléenne de la négation
    negation as neg ->  ext.value = create('boolean'),  ext.value = neg "value";
  } "negation";
}

// Mapping CDA TS vers FHIR instant (TS = timestamp CDA)
group TSInstant(source src : TS, target tgt : instant) extends Any <<types>> {
  // La valeur temporelle CDA est convertie en string pour alimenter l’instant FHIR
  src.value as v -> tgt.value = cast(v, 'string');
}

// Mapping CDA TS vers FHIR dateTime (Hérite du mapping TSInstant)
group TSDateTime(source src : TS, target tgt : dateTime) extends TSInstant <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping parent
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA TS vers FHIR date (Hérite aussi du mapping TSInstant)
group TSDate(source src : TS, target tgt : date) extends TSInstant <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping parent
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA IVL_TS vers FHIR Period
// IVL_TS = intervalle de temps CDA
// Period = période FHIR avec start et end
group IVLTSPeriod(source src : IVL_TS, target tgt : Period) extends Any <<types>> {
  // La borne basse CDA devient le start FHIR
  src.low as low -> tgt.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start);
  // La borne haute CDA devient le end FHIR
  src.high as high -> tgt.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end);
}

// Mapping CDA IVL_TS vers FHIR dateTime (On utilise uniquement la borne basse low)
group IVLTSDateTime(source src : IVL_TS, target tgt : dateTime) extends Any <<types>> {
  // La borne basse est transformée en dateTime
  src.low as s then TSDateTime(s, tgt);
}

// Mapping CDA ST vers FHIR string (ST = texte simple CDA)
group STstring(source src : ST, target tgt : string) {
  // Le texte CDA est converti en string FHIR
  src as v -> tgt.value = cast(v, 'string') "value";
}

// Mapping CDA ED vers FHIR string (ED hérite du comportement de STstring)
group EDstring(source src : ED, target tgt : string) extends STstring <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping STstring
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA ON vers FHIR string (ON = Organization Name CDA)
group ONstring(source src : ON, target tgt : string) extends STstring <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping STstring
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA CS vers FHIR code (CS = coded simple CDA)
group CSCode(source src : CS, target tgt : code) {
  // Le code CDA devient la valeur du code FHIR
  src.code as c -> tgt.value = cast(c, 'string');
}

// Mapping CDA CE vers FHIR code (CE hérite du mapping CSCode)
group CECode(source src : CE, target tgt : code) extends CSCode <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping CSCode
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA CD vers FHIR code (CD hérite du mapping CSCode)
group CDCode(source src : CD, target tgt : code) extends CSCode <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping CSCode
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

group CECodeableConcept(source src : CE, target tgt : CodeableConcept) {
  // originalText CDA -> FHIR CodeableConcept.text
  // Exemple CDA :
  // <originalText>
  // <reference value="#allergie-01-agent"/>
  // </originalText>
  // Résultat FHIR attendu :
  // "text": "#allergie-01-agent"
  // On récupère uniquement reference.value, pas tout l’objet originalText.
  src.originalText as originalText then {
    originalText.reference as ref then {
      ref.value as value -> tgt.text = cast(value, 'string') "textFromOriginalTextReference";
    } "originalTextReference";
  };
  // Création du coding principal à partir du code CDA
  src -> tgt.coding as coding then {
    // CDA code -> FHIR Coding.code.
    src.code as code -> coding.code = cast(code, 'code');
    // CDA codeSystem LOINC -> FHIR Coding.system.
    src.codeSystem as system where (system = '2.16.840.1.113883.6.1') -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "systemLoinc";
    // CDA codeSystem SNOMED CT -> FHIR Coding.system.
    src.codeSystem as system where (system = '2.16.840.1.113883.6.96') -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "systemSnomed";
    // CDA codeSystem HL7 v3 ActCode -> FHIR Coding.system.
    src.codeSystem as system where (system = '2.16.840.1.113883.5.4') -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode' "systemActCode";
    // CDA codeSystem TRE_A02 -> FHIR Coding.system NOS.
    src.codeSystem as system where (system = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.4.5') -> coding.system = 'https://mos.esante.gouv.fr/NOS/TRE_A02-ProfessionSavFaire-CISIS/FHIR/TRE-A02-ProfessionSavFaire-CISIS' "systemTRE_A02";
    // CDA autres codeSystem OID -> FHIR Coding.system urn:oid.
    src.codeSystem as system where ((system != '2.16.840.1.113883.6.1') and (system != '2.16.840.1.113883.6.96') and (system != '2.16.840.1.113883.5.4') and (system != '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.4.5')) -> coding.system = append('urn:oid:', system) "systemFallback";
    // CDA displayName -> FHIR Coding.display.
    // Ici on met le display pour tous les systèmes, y compris LOINC.
    src.displayName as display -> coding.display = cast(display, 'string') "display";
  } "code";
}

// Mapping CDA CS vers FHIR CodeableConcept (CS réutilise la logique CECodeableConcept)
group CSCodeableConcept(source src : CS, target tgt : CodeableConcept) extends CECodeableConcept <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping CECodeableConcept
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA CD vers FHIR CodeableConcept (CD réutilise la logique CECodeableConcept)
group CDCodeableConcept(source src : CD, target tgt : CodeableConcept) extends CECodeableConcept <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping CECodeableConcept
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA CD / CE vers FHIR Coding (Utilisé quand la cible FHIR attend directement un Coding, par exemple Encounter.class)
group CDCoding(source src, target tgt : Coding) {
  // CDA code -> FHIR Coding.code
  src.code as code -> tgt.code = cast(code, 'code');
  // CDA codeSystem LOINC -> FHIR Coding.system
  src.codeSystem as system where (system = '2.16.840.1.113883.6.1') -> tgt.system = 'http://loinc.org' "systemLoinc";
  // CDA codeSystem SNOMED CT -> FHIR Coding.system
  src.codeSystem as system where (system = '2.16.840.1.113883.6.96') -> tgt.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "systemSnomed";
  // CDA codeSystem HL7 v3 ActCode -> FHIR Coding.system
  src.codeSystem as system where (system = '2.16.840.1.113883.5.4') -> tgt.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode' "systemActCode";
  // CDA codeSystem TRE_A02 -> FHIR Coding.system NOS
  src.codeSystem as system where (system = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.4.5') -> tgt.system = 'https://mos.esante.gouv.fr/NOS/TRE_A02-ProfessionSavFaire-CISIS/FHIR/TRE-A02-ProfessionSavFaire-CISIS' "systemTRE_A02";
  // CDA autres codeSystem OID -> FHIR Coding.system urn:oid
  src.codeSystem as system where ((system != '2.16.840.1.113883.6.1') and (system != '2.16.840.1.113883.6.96') and (system != '2.16.840.1.113883.5.4') and (system != '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.4.5')) -> tgt.system = append('urn:oid:', system) "systemFallback";
  // CDA displayName -> FHIR Coding.display
  src.displayName as display -> tgt.display = cast(display, 'string') "display";
}

// Mapping CDA EN vers FHIR HumanName
// EN = Entity Name CDA
// HumanName = nom humain FHIR
group ENHumanName(source src : EN, target tgt : HumanName) {
  // Parcours des composants du nom CDA
  src.item as item then {
    // Nom de famille
    item.family as v -> tgt.family = (v.xmlText);
    // Prénom
    item.given as v -> tgt.given = (v.xmlText);
    // Préfixe du nom
    item.prefix as v -> tgt.prefix = (v.xmlText);
    // Suffixe du nom
    item.suffix as v -> tgt.suffix = (v.xmlText);
  };
  // La période de validité CDA devient period FHIR
  src.validTime as validTime -> tgt.period = validTime;
}

// Mapping CDA PN vers FHIR HumanName
// PN = Person Name CDA
// PN hérite du mapping ENHumanName
group PNHumanName(source src : PN, target tgt : HumanName) extends ENHumanName <<types>> {
  // Réutilisation du mapping ENHumanName
  src -> tgt "inherit";
}

// Mapping CDA AD vers FHIR Address
// AD = adresse CDA
// Address = adresse FHIR
group ADAddress(source src : AD, target tgt : Address) {
  // Parcours des composants de l’adresse CDA
  src.item as item then {
    // Pays
    item.country as v -> tgt.country = (v.xmlText);
    // Région / état
    item.state as v -> tgt.state = (v.xmlText);
    // Département / district
    item.county as v -> tgt.district = (v.xmlText);
    // Ville
    item.city as v -> tgt.city = (v.xmlText);
    // Code postal
    item.postalCode as v -> tgt.postalCode = (v.xmlText);
    // Ligne d’adresse complète
    item.streetAddressLine as v -> tgt.line = (v.xmlText);
    // Ajout éventuel d’une extension sur la ligne d’adresse pour le censusTract
    item -> tgt.line as line then {
      item where (src.censusTract.exists()) then {
        // Mapping du censusTract dans une extension de line
        item.censusTract as v -> line.extension as ext1 then CensusTract(v, ext1) "line";
      } "sfgfdsg";
    } "CensusTract";
    // Anciennes tentatives de mapping du censusTract, conservées en commentaire
    // as streetAddress then{
    // src.censusTract as v->tgt.line as line, line.extension as ext1 then CensusTract(v, ext1) "line";
    // src.censusTract as v ->tgt.line as line, line.extension as ext1 then CensusTract(v, ext1) "line";
    // Nom de rue
    item.streetName as v -> tgt.line = (v.xmlText);
    // Numéro de maison
    item.houseNumber as v -> tgt.line = (v.xmlText);
  };
  // Période d’utilisation de l’adresse
  src.useablePeriod as useablePeriod -> tgt.period = useablePeriod;
}

// Mapping CDA TEL vers FHIR ContactPoint
// TEL = téléphone/email/url CDA
// ContactPoint = moyen de contact FHIR
group TELContactPoint(source src : TEL, target tgt : ContactPoint) {
  // Si la valeur commence par tel:, c’est un téléphone
  src.value as v where (src.value.startsWith('tel:')) ->  tgt.value = (v.substring(4)),  tgt.system = 'phone' "valuetel";
  // Si la valeur commence par fax:, c’est un fax
  src.value as v where (src.value.startsWith('fax:')) ->  tgt.value = (v.substring(4)),  tgt.system = 'fax' "valuefax";
  // Si la valeur commence par mailto:, c’est un email
  src.value as v where (src.value.startsWith('mailto:')) ->  tgt.value = (v.substring(7)),  tgt.system = 'email' "valuemail";
  // Si la valeur commence par http:, c’est une URL
  src.value as v where (src.value.startsWith('http:')) ->  tgt.value = (v.substring(5)),  tgt.system = 'url' "valuehttp";
  // Usage domicile
  src.use where (src.use.startsWith('H')) -> tgt.use = 'home' "usehome";
  // Usage professionnel
  src.use where ((src.use = 'WP') or (src.use = 'DIR') or (src.use = 'PUB')) -> tgt.use = 'work' "usework";
  // Ancien contact / mauvais contact
  src.use where (src.use = 'BAD') -> tgt.use = 'old' "usebad";
  // Contact temporaire
  src.use where (src.use = 'TMP') -> tgt.use = 'temp' "usetmp";
  // Contact mobile
  src.use where (src.use = 'MC') -> tgt.use = 'mobile' "usemobile";
  // Période d’utilisation du contact
  src.useablePeriod as useablePeriod -> tgt.period = useablePeriod; // use: for src.use as c make tgt.use = translate(c, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/ConceptMap/cm-telecom-use-v3', 'code')
}

// Mapping CDA PQ vers FHIR Quantity
// PQ = quantité physique CDA
// Quantity = quantité FHIR
group PQQuantity(source src : PQ, target tgt : Quantity) {
  // Unité lisible
  src.unit as unit -> tgt.unit = unit;
  // Code de l’unité
  src.unit as unit -> tgt.code = unit;
  // Système UCUM pour les unités
  src.unit as unit -> tgt.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org';
  // Valeur numérique de la quantité
  src.value as value -> tgt.value = value;
}

// Mapping CDA RTO_PQ_PQ vers FHIR Ratio
// RTO_PQ_PQ = ratio CDA composé d’un numérateur et d’un dénominateur
// Ratio = ratio FHIR
group RTOPQPQRatio(source src : RTO_PQ_PQ, target tgt : Ratio) {
  // Mapping du numérateur
  src.numerator as numerator -> tgt.numerator as targetNumerator then PQQuantity(numerator, targetNumerator);
  // Mapping du dénominateur
  src.denominator as denominator -> tgt.denominator as targetDenominator then PQQuantity(denominator, targetDenominator);
}

rule.name: originalText
rule.documentation:
originalText CDA -> FHIR CodeableConcept.text
Exemple CDA :
<originalText>
<reference value="#allergie-01-agent"/>
</originalText>
Résultat FHIR attendu :
"text": "#allergie-01-agent"
On récupère uniquement reference.value, pas tout l’objet originalText.
